text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some traditional leaders of the Lozi tribe in Zambia's Western province are calling for the secession of the province to Namibia, provincial minister Michael Mabenga said.
- The Copperbelt University, one of Zambia's two universities, may not reopen in February as scheduled because the government has not allocated it with funding for the new academic year.
- Zambia has increased security at its northern border to police the stream of refugees from war-torn eastern Zaire entering the country.
- Wildlife officers in Zambia's Southern province arrested two men in possession of 14 pairs of elephant tusks.
